新規事業は「アイデアを作る仕事」ではない――Kill uncertainty cheaply, then scale the bet

A new business is often managed as if the job were to generate a good idea, write a plan, win approval, and execute. This essay reframes it as uncertainty management: list the assumptions that must be true, attack the most fatal and least-tested ones with cheap experiments, and increase investment only as evidence gets stronger. It connects Customer Development, Lean Startup, Discovery-Driven Planning, Stage-Gate thinking, and ambidextrous organization into seven practical gates.
